units.title: SG-6.4 · Wire Approve, Retry and Reject in AdminApp
Act: Add rejectExecution to the admin client
Act: Add Reject control to ExecutionPanel
Act: Wire execution actions in AdminApp
Verify: rejectExecution unit tests with mocked fetch

tests.id: executions.test.ts > rejectExecution > POSTs to the reject endpoint with Bearer token and returns the execution
tests.name: rejectExecution sends POST with Bearer token and returns the execution
tests.title: POSTs to the reject endpoint with Bearer token and returns the execution
tests.scenario: Given fetch is stubbed to return executionFixture with status 200, When rejectExecution('secret', 'exec-1') is called, Then fetch is called once with '/api/v1/admin/executions/exec-1/reject', method 'POST', Authorization 'Bearer secret', and the result equals executionFixture

tests.name: rejectExecution rejects with ApiError 401
tests.title: rejects with ApiError 401
tests.scenario: Given fetch is stubbed to return status 401, When rejectExecution('bad', 'exec-1') is called, Then the promise rejects with an ApiError whose status is 401

units.title: Verify: ExecutionPanel Reject control unit tests

tests.id: actions.test.tsx::shows a Reject button for an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution and calls onReject once with its id
tests.name: shows a Reject button for an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution and calls onReject once with its id
tests.title: Shows a Reject button for an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution and calls onReject once with its id
tests.scenario: Given an ExecutionPanel with status AWAITING_APPROVAL, id EX1, and an onReject mock, When the user clicks the Reject button, Then onReject is called exactly once with 'EX1'.

tests.id: actions.test.tsx::shows no Reject button for a FAILED execution even when onReject is provided
tests.name: shows no Reject button for a FAILED execution even when onReject is provided
tests.title: Shows no Reject button for a FAILED execution even when onReject is provided
tests.scenario: Given an ExecutionPanel with status FAILED and an onReject handler provided, When the panel renders, Then no button named Reject is in the document.

units.title: Verify: AdminApp approve, retry, reject and 401 unit tests with mocked fetch

tests.name: approve POSTs with Bearer token and refetches executions
tests.title: Approve POSTs to approve with the bearer token and refetches executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Approve is clicked, then it POSTs to approve with the bearer token and refetches executions

tests.name: retry POSTs with Bearer token and refetches executions
tests.title: Retry POSTs to retry with the bearer token and refetches executions
tests.scenario: Given a FAILED execution, when Retry is clicked, then it POSTs to retry with the bearer token and refetches executions

tests.name: reject POSTs with Bearer token and refetches executions
tests.title: Reject POSTs to reject and refetches executions
tests.scenario: Given an AWAITING_APPROVAL execution, when Reject is clicked, then it POSTs to reject and refetches executions

tests.name: action 401 returns to token gate with Invalid token
tests.title: A 401 from an execution action returns to the token gate with Invalid token
tests.scenario: Given an action responds 401, when it is clicked, then the token gate returns with Invalid token

tests.name: action 500 shows the status in the alert
tests.title: A 500 from an execution action shows the status in the alert
tests.scenario: Given an action responds 500, when it is clicked, then the alert shows the 500 status

units.title: REQ · rejectExecution client call POSTs to the reject endpoint
REQ · ExecutionPanel shows a Reject control for executions awaiting approval
REQ · AdminApp runs execution actions, reloads, shows errors and returns to the token gate on 401
